style: anime storyboard, clean lineart, flat muted colors, soft cel shading, consistent character design, very aesthetic, masterpiece
global_prompt: 2girls, four consecutive moments in a quiet cafe. The black-haired woman in red sits on the left, the blonde woman in blue sits on the right. Exactly one plain white ceramic tumbler without a handle in each panel. Top row medium two-shots across a wooden table, beige wall and window at left. Bottom row changes to close-ups of the SAME cup and the SAME red and blue sleeves, hands only, neutral tabletop background. Cup transfer from red woman to blue woman. Read left to right then down.

B.appearance: woman, blonde bob hair, blue cardigan, white shirt

negative: lowres, watermark, logo, speech bubbles, text, bad anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate objects
